mission: Staging moves to staging.cardpirate.app (owner decision 2026-10-24; Vercel alias keeps working). The API's staging CORS default allows exactly both addresses (credentials still never cross-origin; the Railway CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS variable, if set, must list both); Verify staging merge, the signed-out web smoke and the state report target the new address. The owner sets AUTH_URL (and NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL) in Vercel before this merges.

Default allows both addresses; lookalike hosts refused; existing cases updated.

resources: Verify staging merge, web smoke, state report
routes: GET https://staging.cardpirate.app/api/version, /api/auth/session, /api/collector-token-check and public pages (verifier and smoke)
